== Naoya Inoue edits ==

I have been editing the "Naoya Inoue" wiki page for the past few months.  Lately, an editor has been adding text which I feel serves no purpose and I would consider abnormal compared to other boxers' wiki page.  These alterations read like fan fiction and and do not tell the facts, rather this individuals skewed view of the boxer known as Naoya Inoue.  I have deleted theirs edits but they always return. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 07:52, 14 November 2024 (UTC)

::I disagree.  I don't feel this gives context as it's one's opinion of how the fight went and I think it takes away from the factual information found on the page. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 21:44, 14 November 2024 (UTC)

::::It being from an article doesn't make it fact.  It is the writer's opinion of what happened in the fight.  "Naoya Inoue beat Adrian Hernandez in a professional boxing match"  That is a fact. Calling Inoue a "pint-sized George Foreman" is not a fact and distracts readers. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 00:24, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

::Comments like this are ridiculous and superfluous.  "Inoue battered Hernández, like an unknown singer on the X Factor blowing everyone away the second she opens her mouth." [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 22:05, 14 November 2024 (UTC)

::::Everyone thought that "Inoue battered Hernandez, like an unknown singer on the X Factor..."  I'm not even sure what that means.  It's not stating facts, it's making some strange analogy and readers will have to trudge through these descriptions of the fight to get to the facts.  I just think we need to lose all the flowery descriptions of Inoue's fights and be more succinct in our edits. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 00:21, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

::::::I know what you mean, I just don't think it belongs on a wikipedia page.  Like Cassiopeia said, we need to maintain a neutral point of view and only state facts.  I'm a huge Inoue fan like you and I agree with most of what you put on the page.  I just think we have to stay neutral. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 01:18, 15 November 2024 (UTC)
:::::::Understood.  I will provide edit summary for all future edits.  Thank you [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 00:39, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

:::::::::Hello Cassiopeia, I attempted to condense the play-by play content in the "Inoue vs. Nery" section but it all is back as it was this morning.  Did I edit the page incorrectly? [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 20:33, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

:::::::::Whenever I attempt to remove the "play by play content" like you suggested, Ronten 5 puts it right back in.  I'm at a loss for what to do here. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann|talk]]) 02:39, 16 November 2024 (UTC)
User talk:Deaxmann: :Hello Cassiopeia, I have been editing the "Naoya Inoue" page for a short time.  Recently, someone has been making edits that I feel are not needed and add nothing to the information found on the page.  Here is an example of edits that I feel serve no purpose and fill up the page with meaningless text: "Inoue battered Hernández, like an unknown singer on the X Factor blowing everyone away the second she opens her mouth." [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann#top|talk]]) 22:38, 14 November 2024 (UTC)

:Thank you.  Cassiopeia says we should also remove all the "play-by-play content" meaning the descriptions of what happened during his fights. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann#top|talk]]) 01:24, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

:::I think it's possible but we would have to edit it down to lose all the flowery parts.  We would need to be as neutral as we can. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann#top|talk]]) 01:30, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

:::::I disagree.  I think the whole description is flowery.  Remember, we just need to write the facts.  "20 seconds after the opening bell, Inoue did as his fans hoped, launched a right-hand missile but it missed by a mile. No matter, Inoue went swinging for it again. Two times. Three times. And then, as both attempted wild strikes, Nery missed a left hook by a huge margin. Then, suddenly, as the fighters came in close and Inoue attacked, he had left himself wide open and Nery saw a gap. The Mexican southpaw reached around the corner with a left hook, and the impossible was on. Inoue spiraled to the canvas. Inoue appeared clear in his eyes and listened to the count of referee Michael Griffin while perched on one knee."  I don't think any of this is necessary.  This works for an article written about the match but not for a wikipedia page.  I would instead write something like "In the first round, Inoue was dropped to the canvas for the first time in his career by way of a left hook.  Inoue returned the favor, sending Nery down to the canvas in the 2nd, 5th and finally in the 6th round to win the fight by TKO."  That gets straight to the point and neatly sums up the high points of the bout. [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann#top|talk]]) 01:55, 15 November 2024 (UTC)

:Can't you see that calling Inoue's punches "perfect" and saying he "dominated" are not neutral.  They are opinions of the author.  I also don't believe you're fine with that, if you were, you would have discussed this with me before instead of continuously reverting my edits.  You have been warned multiple times about this, yet you continue to do it. @[[User:Mac Dreamstate|Mac Dreamstate]] [[User:Deaxmann|Deaxmann]] ([[User talk:Deaxmann#top|talk]]) 01:48, 18 November 2024 (UTC)

" just thirty seconds - we put in thirty seconds into x round" - the word just is an adverb - dont use it" and many more of such example.
